description: Identify the seat role by stable tenant-scoped ownership and reserve its identity during creation, import and rename.
Protect the managed role definition and its canonical permission set through UI actions, APIs and bulk writes.
Reserve seat-role assignment and removal for seat lifecycle operations, including conversion and revocation.
Keep the role and its grants inspectable as read-only for authorized MSP administrators in eligible tenants. Identify the arrangement as the place to manage scope.
Exclude the role from manual role selectors and editing controls, and suppress it on general role surfaces for tenants without the capability.
Reconcile legacy seat roles and grants across existing arrangements safely and idempotently. Preserve legitimate assignments, unrelated roles and tenant isolation.
